goal: Refine the zeroxB canvas to use React Flow-style selection and relationship interactions: right-drag marquee selection on empty canvas, live right-hold relationship previews, editable routed relationship paths, exact-area block creation, and removal of obsolete shape shortcuts, then rebuild, reinstall, and verify the Windows application.
non_goals: Do not replace React Flow or redesign the bottom AI conversation surface.
Do not add export features, cloud sync, or non-Windows packaging.
Do not move user-authored blocks or rewrite their content.
Do not expose or commit the localhost model API credential.
acceptance_criteria: Right-dragging empty canvas renders a marquee and selects every node that partially intersects it; the selected set can be deleted in one operation and restored through undo.
A right click without a drag keeps the existing context-menu behavior, while right-holding a node starts a relationship drag without creating a text block.
The relationship preview follows the pointer in real time with a React Flow-style curved path and highlights a valid target.
Saved relationships default to a curved route and can be reopened from their context menu to change route type, color, width, dash style, arrows, and manual routing points.
Relationship routing points remain editable after save and changes participate in undo history.
A click or single-axis drag on empty canvas creates nothing; a two-dimensional drag creates a text block using the drawn dimensions without the previous 120 by 72 minimum.
The process, decision, terminator, and text quick-create toolbar buttons shown in the supplied screenshot are removed.

Canvas interaction tests, TypeScript checks, frontend build, locked Cargo check, NSIS packaging, F-drive reinstall, responsive launch, local AI configuration persistence, and canvas startup verification pass.
context_sources: src/app/core/main/canvas/canvas-editor.tsx is the manual integration source for pointer routing, React Flow configuration, overlays, context menus, and the toolbar.
src/app/core/main/canvas/canvas-relation-editor.tsx is the manual integration source for the line-adjacent relationship editor.
src/types/canvas.ts defines persisted relationship data and must remain backward compatible with existing canvases.
src/lib/canvas/gesture-policy.ts and src/lib/canvas/relation-policy.ts are testable policy seams.
User-supplied screenshots define the obsolete quick actions and the desired React Flow-style visual behavior.
notes: Use the fixed UTF-8 I/O baseline.
Partial overlap is the approved marquee-selection rule.
Preserve middle-button canvas panning and single right-click context menus.
Relationship routing changes must not reposition manually placed nodes.
Never print or include the API credential in reports, commits, source files, or verification evidence.
